ops.title: test_cli.py subprocess tests fail on this macOS box with a sandbox PermissionError reading a /private/var/mobile .gitignore — environmental, green in CI

ops.body:
On this macOS (Tahoe 26.x) machine, `tests/test_cli.py` subprocess tests (TestCLIWithContext, TestTranscriptWiring, TestFlags) fail with `PermissionError: [Errno 13] Permission denied: '/private/var/mobile/Library/ExternalAccessory/.gitignore'` — the `python -m captain_hook` CLI walks parent dirs looking for a repo root / .gitignore and hits a sandboxed system path. Returncode 1, so `assert result.returncode == 0` fails.

This is a local sandbox artifact, not a code bug: it passes in CI (ubuntu-latest). When judging "full suite green" locally, discount these test_cli.py failures as environmental noise. Related macOS-harness gotcha: [[tahoe-syspolicyd-storm]] — process-spawning harnesses pin syspolicyd on macOS 26.x.
